import bz2
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
ns = "{http://www.mediawiki.org/xml/export-0.11/}"
with bz2.open("biwiki.xml.bz2", "rb") as f:
    for _, page in ET.iterparse(f, events=("end",)):
        if page.tag == ns + "page":
            print(page.findtext(ns + "title"))
            page.clear()
